qualification: Explicit cursor adapter namespace independent of native directory-ID availability. Default injected cursors report Unsupported; native POSIX/Windows and simulated cursors return the actual adapter token. Codec rejects foreign child IDs. Namespace continuity rechecked before publication.

Fifteen new unit cases cover native-End publication, original IDs in canonical name order, unavailable directory IDs, every unavailable namespace state with no scratch creation, duplicate names across sorted page boundaries, cancellation at every advance and during native read, changed directory timestamps/namespace, foreign root/child IDs, per-entry metadata failures, enumeration/byte/file/create failures, empty input, abandonment and outstanding result lifetime, exceptions, encoding mismatch, uncertain root metadata and Gone, invalid model/generation, and no inference from default cursor identity.

Two new native cases: stream 259 real top-level entries using listing7/sort16/check11-or16 bounded pages, retain original ordinal permutation and actual adapter namespaces, regular-file sizes/kinds, untraversed directory and final symlink/junction, final pinned identity and owner/ledger cleanup; mutate directory modification time after enumeration and reject Changed with no result.

Before/after root observations reject explicit native-ID/time/kind/namespace differences and Gone/Changed; unavailable root observations retained as uncertainty. Matching observations are not snapshot proof, and unchanged child contents or all concurrent mutations are not established.

All 78 Files suites pass on all hosts. Fifty-eight core/platform/host/test units rebuilt directly for sanitizers; runtime focused scope codec17+store34+sorter12+listing15+native16/14/13. ASan+UBSan Mac/Linux; Linux leak detection enabled, Mac disabled/unavailable; Windows ASan. Existing synthetic 100000-record scan/sort tests still pass; this does not substitute for 100000 real-directory qualification.

limitations: WP-01 remains in progress; WP-02 through WP-08 unstarted. Disk rank/ID addressing and pane providers, generation/selection/acquisition integration, destination preservation/collision capability completion and broader filesystem/provider qualification remain required.

CompletedDirectoryIndex is a worker-owned cache result, never UI generation acceptance, source snapshot, pathname attestation or native mutation authority. Native enumeration plus root brackets can miss unreported changes. Fresh acquisition and revalidation remain mandatory for later operations.

Unknown/denied root/entry metadata stays explicit; this browsing result does not certify preservation or bypass loss consent. Row ordinals persist only through projections of the same dataset, not refresh or ID reuse.

Production collection retains one bounded native batch, bounded sorter state, or one bounded check page plus previous name; quota failures have no RAM fallback. Physical memory/RSS/metadata IO/kernel cache are not bounded by encoded wire quotas. Native calls may block and cooperative cancellation is terminal for the collector.

259 real entries verify integration on APFS/ext4/ReFS, not large real-directory throughput, memory or full-app latency. Synthetic100000-record workloads remain separate. Network/removable/provider/crash/full-disk and different-account qualification remains outstanding.

Outstanding issued results retain their native/store owners after job abandonment and need the future pane generation/revocation gate. Result and store I/O, retirement and all native queries remain worker-serialized.
